lane: تَرَبَّلَ 5 see 1, in two places. ___ تربِّلت الأَرْضُ _The land had trees such as are termed_ رَبْل; i. e. _breaking forth with green leaves, without rain, when the season had become cool to them, and the summer had retired:_ (As, A'Obeyd, T:) or _the land became green after dryness, at the advent of autumn._ (S.) And تربّل الشَّجَرُ _The trees put forth leaves such as are termed_ رَبْل. (M, K. *) === تربّل also signifies _He ate_ رَبْل; (Ibn-'Abbád, K;) said of a gazelle. (Ibn-'Abbád, TA.) And _They_ (a company of men) _pastured their cattle upon_ رَبْل. (M, K.) And _He prosecuted a search after_ رَبْل. (Ibn-'Abbád, K.) === Also _He took, captured, caught, snared,_ or _trapped;_ or _sought to take_ &c.; _game,_ or _wild animals,_ or _the like._ (M, K.) You say, خَرَجُوا يَتَرَبَّلُونَ _They went forth to take_ &c., or _seeking to take_ &c., _game_ &c. (M.)
